assets.name: memory-map
assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate a new rich educational diagram in the style of the reference: warm ivory, deep teal, orange accents, soft shaded documents, crisp typography and generous whitespace. Reference is style only. Landscape 3:2, large easily readable labels. Main title exactly "WHAT DOES AN AGENT NEED TO REMEMBER?". Three zones. Left 'Working context' with a small desk holding 'Current question', 'Relevant evidence', 'Next action'. Middle 'Thread memory' with a resumable case folder 'Messages', 'Tool results', 'Pending checks'. Right large shelf labelled 'Long-term memory' holding three distinct files 'Episodic: past events', 'Semantic: facts', 'Procedural: approved methods'. Arrow from shelf and case folder to desk 'Select for this task'. Bottom 'Retain deliberately. Retrieve selectively.' These zones are distinct, not sequential maturity stages. No industrial machines. Avoid em dashes, logos, tiny text, invented numeric results. Make arrows unambiguous.
